     * (validatePlaceholders/proceedWithPreview) before it will generate a
     * document. Adapted to this component's data model: instead of that
     * component's canvas placeholder array, an unresolved value here is a
     * live <input>/<select>/<textarea> (or a signature's "Upload Signature"
     * trigger) sitting inside a '.quill-placeholder-embed' node, so the
     * check reads those controls straight out of the Quill DOM.

classMembers.name: addImageSizesToPdfDelta
classMembers.doc:
*
     * A Quill image carries only alt / height / width into the Delta, so an
     * image inserted without them reaches the renderer with NO size and is
     * drawn at its full natural pixel size - a phone photo is many times the
     * content box, overflows the page and prints blank. Small images happened
     * to fit, which is why only large ones were affected.
     *
     * The rendered size in the editor is sent instead, capped to the page
     * content box the same way buildBandHtmlForPdf caps band logos, so the PDF
     * shows what the editor shows.
     *
     * The cap is the content height MINUS the line box overhead. An image is
     * inline, so it sits on the text baseline and its paragraph is a few px
     * taller than the image - the strut's descender. An image sized to the
     * full content height therefore produces a block that does not fit, and
     * the renderer moves it to the next page and leaves this one empty.

classMembers.name: resolvePdfControls
classMembers.doc:
*
     * Replace every manual control in the PDF clone with the value the user
     * actually entered, styled with the placeholder's own font.
     *
     * An <input>/<textarea>/<select> keeps its current value in a DOM
     * *property*, not in the HTML attribute, so cloneNode(true) copies an
     * empty control. Values are therefore read from the live editor and
     * written into the clone as text nodes. The live editor is never touched.

classMembers.name: syncListMarkerFormats
classMembers.doc:
*
     * Quill 2 draws a list's number / bullet from `li > .ql-ui::before`. That
     * marker is a SIBLING of the line's text, not an ancestor of it, so the
     * <strong> / <em> / <u> / <span style="color"> a toolbar format wraps the
     * text in never reaches it - a fully bold list line renders a
     * regular-weight "1." next to bold text.
     *
     * The marker does inherit from the <li>, so the line's formatting is
     * mirrored onto the <li> itself. Quill's getFormat() reports a format only
     * when it is uniform across the whole range (mixed values come back as an
     * array, never as `true`), so bolding a single word inside a list item
     * correctly leaves the marker alone - the same rule Word and Google Docs
     * apply to list markers.
     *
     * Called from repaginate() because every path that changes the document -
     * typing, toolbar clicks, keyboard shortcuts and each of the innerHTML
     * loads - already funnels through it, and because Quill rebuilds a list
     * blot's DOM node on structural edits, which drops styles written outside
     * Parchment. Re-applying here repairs that.

classMembers.name: setListMarkerStyle
classMembers.doc:
*
     * Writing an unchanged value still counts as a DOM mutation, which Quill's
     * MutationObserver picks up and reconciles on its next update - so only
     * touch the node when the value actually differs.
